title: Investigation of a sulfonic acid functionalized ammonium-based permanganate hybrid as a sustainable oxidative catalyst for selective conversion of organic sulfides to sulfoxides
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00760C, Paper

Sangeeta Kalita, Niharika Kashyap, Prapti Priyam Handique, Debanga Bhusan Bora, Ruli Borah
Permanganate hybrids of N,N′-diethyldisulfoammonium ([DEDSA]+) and 1,4-disulfopiperazinium ([DSPZ]2+) cations were developed as recyclable oxidative catalysts for the selective conversion of organic sulfides to sulfoxides in dilute H2SO4 solution.
